config.registered: 2026-11-23, after extraction_challenge_v3 was frozen and before the per-lesion training data, model or any run

design.token_heads: BIO tags for every liver-lesion size phrase, and for the stated lesion count
design.span_heads: on each lesion size span (mean of its tokens): segments (8 + stated), attenuation (3 + unstated), repeat of an earlier mention, largest lesion (amendment 1)
design.document_head: count source: none (no lesion) / number (read the tagged count) / enumerated (count distinct lesions) / unstated
design.decoding: largest lesion = the tagged span with the highest 'largest' probability (amendment 1); diameter, segments and attenuation come from that span; count from the count source. No rule reads the report text except to parse tagged numbers.

amendments.when: after registration, before the per-lesion training data, model code or any run
amendments.change: added a per-span 'largest' head whose input also has two features computed from the tagged spans' parsed dimensions (is the longest dimension among spans; dimension / longest dimension). Decoding takes the span with the highest 'largest' probability instead of the longest dimension.
amendments.reason: source labels name the largest lesion by segmentation volume; in 47 of 1,029 lesion-positive Train reports (6 of 220 in Validation) that lesion does not have the longest written dimension, so the registered rule would have failed those by construction.

config.epochs_note: raised from 4 because the Validation loss of every 4-epoch run was still falling at epoch 4
config.loss: sum of the head losses, unweighted; span heads are trained on the gold spans

selection_criteria.fixed_before: the per-lesion training data, model code and first run
selection_criteria.model_selection: epoch with the lowest Validation loss; Challenge Sets are never used to choose an epoch, seed or setting
selection_criteria.primary_v3: on extraction_challenge_v3 (held out), for every field and every seed: pooled accuracy over the subtypes that target the field is at least the parser's and at least the first model's (same seed) minus 0.01; and for count, segments and diameter it is higher than the first model's (same seed) with exact McNemar p < 0.05
selection_criteria.no_regression_v2: on extraction_challenge_v2_liver, for every field and every seed, pooled targeted accuracy is at least the first model's (same seed) minus 0.01
selection_criteria.no_regression_val: on lesion-positive Validation studies, accuracy against the extraction targets is at least the parser's minus 0.01 and the first model's (same seed) minus 0.01, per field and seed
selection_criteria.no_hidden_regression: across extraction_challenge_v2_liver and extraction_challenge_v3, no subtype where the parser scores at least 0.95 on a targeted field has a mean model accuracy (over seeds) below 0.95 on that field
selection_criteria.verdict: model-only candidate if all four hold; otherwise report which fail and keep the hybrid for Phase 8
selection_criteria.test: not read; the system chosen in Phase 8 is evaluated on Test once
